title: Oven-Roasted Egyptian Duck Tagine
description: A citrusy, velvety Egyptian dish featuring a tender duck leg in a rich, flavorful sauce.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 375°F (190°C) and set a rack with a rimmed baking sheet.
Pat dry the duck leg with paper towels and season with salt, black pepper, and cumin.
Air-fry the duck leg for 15 minutes, or until browned and crispy.
Meanwhile, heat the butter and olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned, about 10 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the cinnamon stick, cumin, coriander, and cardamom, and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the orange marmalade and lemon juice, and bring the sauce to a simmer.
Add the browned duck leg to the sauce and transfer the pot to the preheated oven.
Roast for 25 minutes, then baste with the sauce and continue to roast for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the duck is cooked through.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Strain the sauce and discard the solids, then serve the duck with the sauce spooned over the top.
